【世界上的男人有两种，沈珩和其他。】

这一次，轮到沈珩僵在那里了。

韩小汐也不急着等他回应，这句话是她上辈子的口头禅。

没想到有一天可以说给本尊听。

还让本尊听沉默了！

韩小汐恨不能手脚并用的庆祝一下。

她算是调戏成功了吧？！

只听电话那头男人的声音突然

“什么？请客吃饭？”我愣了下，反正是想不出她会给我什么奖励，不过也没有想过是什么好东西，有个心意就好。

一道道黑色的纹路迅速爬满了他的脸和脑袋，眼中也透出了疯狂之色，身体之上更是蓦然有着强大的虚空之力散发而出。

[There are two types of men in the world, Shen Heng and others.】

This time, it was Shen Heng's turn to freeze.

Han Xiaoxi was not in a hurry to wait for his response. This sentence was her mantra in her previous life.

I never thought that one day I would be able to tell you this.

And I was silenced!

Han Xiaoxi wished she could use her hands and feet to celebrate.

Did she succeed in teasing her?!

Just listen to the man's voice on the other end of the phone suddenly

"What? Treat me to dinner?" I was stunned for a moment. I couldn't think of any reward she would give me, but I didn't think about it being a good thing. Just have some intention.

Black lines quickly covered his face and head, a look of madness appeared in his eyes, and powerful void power suddenly emitted from his body.
